title: Drop-down fields of Conditions in Custom Formats flickering with maximized window
body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues

### Current Behavior

The drop-down UI is flickering on a loop, kinda trying to refresh itself. Cannot make a screenshot since the frame is frozen then.

### Expected Behavior

The drop-down UI is static.

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Go to Custom Formats.
2. Add Custom Format.
3. Add Condition
4. Select any condition with a drop-down (i.e. Resolution).
5. Click the drop-down to see the options (Resolution in this case).

### Environment

```markdown
- OS: Windows 11
- Sonarr: 4.0.12.2823
- Browser: Chrome
```

### What branch are you running?

Main

### Trace Logs?

No log entry was created.

### Anything else?

This behavior was not observed in Radarr 5.17.2.9580.
author: 4legom
